applicationRules: Read each latest exampleId and full sentence before applying. Exact before values must still match; reconcile shared-word changes rather than overwrite them.
Apply only evidence-supported fields. Preserve English, cloze, answer, status and all unrelated fields unless an independently justified change is explicitly recorded.
Do not fill intentionally empty daily or exam hints. Broad but applicable hints are refinements, not wholly incorrect entries.
Mixed POS reductions describe the actual cloze token, not removal of headword senses. Keep unresolved phrase, determiner and contraction conventions.

Translation candidates require context review. Preserve original-source quotations and their attribution; never label a corrected translation as a verbatim original. Do not mechanically rewrite kinship terms.
Reopen affected cards and exact illustration-caption routes after saving. Maintain exact before/after recovery, historical baselines and unaffected regression assertions.
